message.content: Project: /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23 (meeting-room booking app; Node 22, built-ins only). Spec: /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/.team/notes/spec.md — read the whole "Page" section. Frontend script: public/app.js. Existing frontend tests: test/page.test.mjs, test/page-list.test.mjs (read both to see the style and avoid duplicates), helper test/helpers/fake-dom.mjs (loadPage(appPath) runs app.js in node:vm with fake elements; `calls` records each fetch {url, options, bookDisabled, reply(replyObj), fail(err)}; makeReply(status, body, {badJson}) gives {status, json(), jsonCalls}; flush() lets promises settle; FakeElement has children, value, disabled, textContent, dispatch(type) returning the event with defaultPrevented, and optional `onTextSet` hook; text nodes are {nodeType: 3, textContent}). Write ONE new test file: /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23/test/page.behaviour.test.mjs. Do NOT edit app.js, the helper or other tests (if you need a richer fake, write small local helpers in your test file). node:test + node:assert/strict. File under ~400 lines, functions under 50 lines, table-driven loops with an assert message per case, exact equality only. No console.log. Write a local `setup()` that loads the page, answers the rooms fetch (calls[0], url '/api/rooms') with 200 {rooms:[...3]} and the first list fetch (calls[1]) with 200 {bookings: [...]} of your choice, and flushes. Booking objects: {id, room, title, date, start, end}. Cases (each a test; a plausible wrong implementation named in brackets must fail): 1. Overlapping list fetches [no generation check / check only on success]: start 3 list fetches (load + two `change` dispatches on filter-date with different values). (a) Resolve the 1st with 200 bookings A and the 2nd with 200 bookings B while the 3rd is still pending -> list unchanged, #error unchanged. Then resolve 3rd with C -> list shows C. Then (b) in another test: 3rd resolves first with C; then 1st replies 500 {error:'boom'} and 2nd fails (fail()) -> list still C and #error '' (empty). (c) earlier 200 with badJson and earlier 409 after the last succeeded -> no change. (d) Last one errors 500 {error:'x'} and an earlier succeeds afterwards -> #error 'x', list as before the fetches. 2. Book button [re-enable after refetch]: on submit, the POST fetch call has bookDisabled === true and els.book.disabled true while pending; reply 201 -> the follow-up GET list call has bookDisabled === false. On 500 reply with {error:'nope'}: use els.error.onTextSet to record els.book.disabled at the moment the error text is set -> false. On fail() -> Book enabled and #error 'Could not reach the server.'. After the request settles, a second submit sends a new POST (2 POSTs total). 3. Submit while disabled [preventDefault only when enabled]: while first POST pending, dispatch submit again -> returned event.defaultPrevented === true and no new fetch call. 4. Exact POST options [trim title / extra headers]: set room 'Cosmos' (value), title ' Plan ', date '2026-11-03', start '09:00', end '10:00'. The POST call: url exactly '/api/bookings'; Object.keys(options) sorted deepEqual ['body','headers','method']; options.method 'POST'; options.headers deepEqual {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} (exactly one key); JSON.parse(options.body) deepEqual {room:'Cosmos', title:' Plan ', date:'2026-11-03', start:'09:00', end:'10:00'} with exactly those five keys. Also with all fields empty strings the POST still goes out (script never checks fields) with empty strings. 5. 201 [clears all fields]: after 201 the title is '' while room/date/start/end and #filter-date keep their values; #error '' (it held an earlier error text before); exactly one new list fetch whose url uses the current filter ('/api/bookings?date=' when filter set). 6. POST with status 200 (not 201) {error:'odd'} [any 2xx is success] -> #error 'odd', title kept, no list fetch. POST 409 {error:'room is already booked from 09:00 to 10:00'} -> #error exactly that. POST error bodies without a string error -> 'Request failed.': {error: 5}, {error: null}, {message:'x'}, [], null, 'str', 42. POST 500 with badJson -> 'Could not reach the server.' and title kept, no list fetch. 7. Cancel: list with booking id 7 and id 12 -> clicking the second li's button (children[1], dispatch('click')) sends url exactly '/api/bookings/12' with options deepEqual {method:'DELETE'} (only that key); button.disabled true while pending. 204 reply made with makeReply(204, undefined, {badJson:true}) [json() read on 204] -> treated as success: #error '' and a list refetch; the reply's jsonCalls === 0. DELETE 404 {error:'booking not found'} -> #error 'booking not found' then a list refetch happens; button enabled. DELETE 200 {} -> 'Request failed.' and refetch. DELETE fail() [refetch on no reply / button not re-enabled] -> #error 'Could not reach the server.', NO new fetch, button.disabled false. DELETE 500 with badJson -> 'Could not reach the server.', no refetch. 8. Filter [encodeURIComponent]: set filter-date value 'a b&c/é' then dispatch 'change' -> url exactly '/api/bookings?date=a b&c/é'; value '2026-11-03' -> '/api/bookings?date=2026-11-03'; value '' -> '/api/bookings'. 'input' event -> no fetch. Show all [doesn't clear / fetches twice]: with filter '2026-11-03', click show-all -> filter value '' and exactly one new fetch with url '/api/bookings'. Also the first list fetch at load uses the filter if it already had a value? (Not possible: app runs at load; skip.) 9. List error handling: list 500 {error:'db down'} -> #error 'db down', list unchanged; list 500 {nope:1} -> 'Request failed.'; list 201 {bookings:[]} (wrong success status) -> error 'Request failed.' and list unchanged; list fail -> 'Could not reach the server.'. 10. Rooms: rooms 500 {error:'r'} -> #error 'r', #room children length 0; rooms fail -> 'Could not reach the server.', #room empty; rooms 200 -> three option elements (tagName 'option'), each value === text === name, in order Aurora, Borealis, Cosmos. 11. Rendering plain text: booking title 'x' -> li.children length 2, children[0] is a text node (nodeType 3) with textContent exactly '2026-11-03 09:00-10:00 Aurora: x', children[1].tagName 'button', type 'button', textContent 'Cancel'; no trailing space. Empty list -> exactly one li with exactly one child, a text node 'No bookings.'. Title with trailing spaces in data ' x ' shown unchanged inside the text. 12. A success list after an error leaves #error alone (error text stays). Run `cd /root/bench-runs/h4-c3e12a23 && node --test test/page.behaviour.test.mjs`. If a case fails because app.js is wrong per spec, do NOT change app.js and do NOT weaken the test: keep it and report the exact failing case. Report: file written, pass/fail counts, suspected app.js spec violations.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.
